Eye-level camera from beside the path, not the old frontal book floating over path. No lower appendages.

badges.name: Salvo pelo Folha
badges.requirement: Ter a sequência salva pelo Marca-página do Folha
badges.story: Com um dedo na boca, o Folha protege o sono de uma pequena fênix sobre a chama azul.
badges.pose: Close lateral inclinado, indicador na boca e a outra mão protegendo a fênix.
badges.direction: Intimate secretive CLOSE SIDE-THREE-QUARTER scene. Folha's face tilts DOWN and INWARD from the UPPER LEFT, very close to a TINY sleeping phoenix curled on a bronze brazier in the LOWER RIGHT. One eye is softly narrowed, the other looks at the sleeping phoenix, a conspiratorial caring expression rather than a big smile. Indigo cap partly behind the tilted book; mint bookmark drapes toward the phoenix. The phoenix's eyes are CLOSED, wings tucked, peaceful; a small magical BLUE flame glows beneath it, contrasting with rich amber surroundings. Preserve the GOLD laurel/cap frame, no fiery frame redesign. No writing or letters.

A pink-peach sun clears the horizon outside, golden steam curls in cool morning light. Cup rests on desk, book floats at cup level with no lower appendages. No clock digits or letters. Preserve a recognizably OPEN BOOK with two broad INNER page planes and center gutter; tilt the whole book toward cup as one coherent object, do NOT bend a page block into a human torso.
